name: @pipeworx/mcp-kansas-code

tools.name: ks_statute
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Kansas Statutes Annotated — Kansas state law — by citation. "K.S.A. 21-5402" is first degree murder. Returns the statutory text. Keyless. Use for "what does K.S.A. 21-5402 say" or to check a Kansas statute a case relies on.

section.description: Section as cited, e.g. "21-5402" (murder 1) or "8-1567" (DUI). The digits after the dash encode article and section.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-kansas-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the kansas-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
